nd_overview: A visual summary of everything you have done: datasets, runs, model accuracy and plan usage.
nd_profile: Manage your account details, password and usage.
nd_plans: Compare plans and manage your subscription.

pp_tag_pro: More room for larger datasets and long projects.

pp_note_up: Pro raises the limits above. All analysis features are already included in the Free plan.
pp_a1: No. This is a demo of how plans would work. Switching only changes your limits.
pp_q2: What happens to my data if I switch back to Free?
pp_a2: Nothing is deleted. You keep everything you saved, but you cannot add new datasets or runs until you are under the Free limits.
pp_a3: Guests can try the main features with small limits. Their data is deleted automatically after 24 hours. A free account keeps it permanently.
